author: Marcus Aurelius
text: Begin the morning by saying to thyself, I shall meet with the busybody, the ungrateful, arrogant, deceitful, envious, unsocial

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: In the morning when thou risest unwillingly, let this thought be present I am rising to the work of a human being

text: Such as are thy habitual thoughts, such also will be the character of thy mind; for the soul is dyed by the thoughts

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: No longer talk at all about the kind of man that a good man ought to be, but be such

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: The best way of avenging thyself is not to become like the wrong doer

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: Look within. Within is the fountain of good, and it will ever bubble up, if thou wilt ever dig

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: Loss is nothing else than change

author: Epictetus
text: Of things some are in our power, and others are not

author: Epictetus
text: Men are disturbed not by the things which happen, but by the opinions about the things

text: Seek not that the things which happen should happen as you wish; but wish the things which happen to be as they are, and you will have a tranquil flow of life

author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
text: Above all, don't lie to yourself. The man who lies to himself and listens to his own lie comes to such a pass that he cannot distinguish the truth within him, or around him, and so loses all respect for himself and for others

text: love in action is a harsh and dreadful thing compared with love in dreams

text: Love all God's creation, the whole and every grain of sand in it. Love every leaf, every ray of God's light

text: To go wrong in one's own way is better than to go right in someone else's

author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
text: It would be interesting to know what it is men are most afraid of. Taking a new step, uttering a new word is what they fear most

author: Leo Tolstoy
text: We imagine that when we are thrown out of our usual ruts all is lost, but it is only then that what is new and good begins. While there is life there is happiness

text: Everything comes in time to him who knows how to wait

text: Seize the moments of happiness, love and be loved! That is the only reality in the world, all else is folly

author: Leo Tolstoy
text: Men are like rivers: the water is the same in each, and alike in all; but every river is narrow here, is more rapid there, here slower, there broader, now clear, now cold, now dull, now warm

author: Leo Tolstoy
text: Faith is the strength of life. If a man lives he believes in something

author: Mary Shelley
text: What can stop the determined heart and resolved will of man

text: Nothing is so painful to the human mind as a great and sudden change

text: I was benevolent and good; misery made me a fiend. Make me happy, and I shall again be virtuous

author: Mary Shelley
text: Beware, for I am fearless and therefore powerful

author: H. G. Wells
text: There is no intelligence where there is no change and no need of change

text: Strength is the outcome of need; security sets a premium on feebleness

author: H. G. Wells
text: And I have by me, for my comfort, two strange white flowers shrivelled now, and brown and flat and brittle to witness that even when mind and strength had gone, gratitude and a mutual tenderness still lived on in the heart of man

author: Edwin A. Abbott
text: it is Knowledge; it is Three Dimensions: open your eye once again and try to look steadily

text: In that blessed region of Four Dimensions, shall we linger at the threshold of the Fifth, and not enter therein

text: Indeed Will is stronger than Fact, it can mould and overcome Fact
